view: Teyuna Ciudad Perdida Colombia elevated ridge view along series of circular and oval low stone-walled terraces linked by narrow stone stairs descending into lush Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta forest, grass-covered empty house platforms, misty mountain backdrop. No intact huts, no Maya pyramids or Inca monumental dressed stone, physically connected steps.

eras.title: Terraces along the ridge
eras.caption: At Teyuna, stone steps connect circular terraces along a steep forested ridge. The surviving platforms once supported buildings of perishable materials; the place remained known to Indigenous communities even when outsiders began calling it the Lost City.
